name: cyango
description: Edit a live Cyango xr/studio story: scenes, layout, models, and interactions.

interface.longDescription:
Cyango edits the story that is open in Cyango xr/studio. Ask for a change in plain words and see it land in the editor: add and arrange scenes, build GUI panels, buttons and text, place 3D models, primitives, lights and Gaussian splats, wire up actions and timelines, and insert free stock images and models with their author and license.

Sign in with your Cyango account when you connect. Then open a story in Cyango xr/studio and turn MCP on in Story Settings. Saving stays a manual step in the editor.

Guide: https://cyango.com/docs/studio/ai-agents-mcp
defaultPrompt: Turn the first scene into a hotel-lobby welcome: a large title, one line of copy, and a Start button.
Stage a showroom in the first scene: a pedestal, a red sphere, and a warm spotlight aimed at it.
Find a free coastline photo, place it in the first scene, and credit the photographer and license.

positive.description: Prerequisites: use a disposable story with a TOUR_3D first scene, signed into the same Cyango account as the plugin; keep xr/studio open with MCP enabled and bridge_status.editorConnected=true. List the scenes of the open story
positive.prompt: Name every scene in the story I have open and give each scene type.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the name and type of each scene in the story open in Cyango xr/studio. Nothing in the story changes.

positive.description: Prerequisites: use a disposable story with a TOUR_3D first scene, signed into the same Cyango account as the plugin; keep xr/studio open with MCP enabled and bridge_status.editorConnected=true. Add a scene
positive.prompt: Add one 3D tour scene called Gallery.
positive.expected_behavior: Exactly one new TOUR_3D scene titled Gallery appears in the connected editor. The tool reports a verified sceneId; no navigation action or publishing is implied. add_scenes with one row is an equivalent valid implementation.

positive.description: Prerequisites: use a disposable story with a TOUR_3D first scene, signed into the same Cyango account as the plugin; keep xr/studio open with MCP enabled and bridge_status.editorConnected=true. Build a GUI panel
positive.prompt: In the first scene, build a screen-space welcome panel: the title Welcome, the line Explore the gallery. under it, and a Start button below. The button does not need an action yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Under the existing GUI_SCREEN of the first scene, a GUI_CONTAINER panel contains Welcome, Explore the gallery., and a visible Start button in that order. The button is a GUI_CONTAINER with a GUI_TEXT label. Text uses en-US and GUI properties use desktop.default. No click action is required. The tool confirms all created IDs; verify visibility in the editor.

positive.description: Prerequisites: use a disposable story with a TOUR_3D first scene, signed into the same Cyango account as the plugin; keep xr/studio open with MCP enabled and bridge_status.editorConnected=true. Add and then change a 3D object
positive.prompt: In the first scene, put a red sphere on a pedestal, then double every component of the sphere scale. Verify its scale after the change.
positive.expected_behavior: A pedestal and a red sphere appear in the first scene. After one batched update, scale.currentValue has doubled on all three axes compared with the created sphere; material.currentValue.color remains red. The reply reports the verified before/after scale. No geometry-only resize.

positive.description: Prerequisites: use a disposable story with a TOUR_3D first scene, signed into the same Cyango account as the plugin; keep xr/studio open with MCP enabled and bridge_status.editorConnected=true. Place a free stock image A configured image provider with working credentials and a free coastline result with author/license metadata is required; verify this before review.
positive.prompt: Find a free coastline photograph, place it in the first scene, and tell me the photographer and the license.
positive.expected_behavior: A coastline photograph selected from a configured free image provider is inserted in the first scene with a verified entityId. The reply credits attribution.author and the returned license (and source/license links when present). Do not invent missing credits. If provider access or metadata is unavailable, report that limitation; it is not a passing positive case.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in Lisbon today?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any Cyango tool: weather is outside this plugin. Answer through an appropriate weather capability if available, or explain that live weather is unavailable. Do not modify the story.

negative.prompt: Buy me a Cyango Pro subscription.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Cyango tools or purchase anything. Explain that the plugin cannot buy subscriptions or process payments; direct the user to the Cyango website to manage a plan. Do not claim a purchase occurred.

negative.prompt: Publish my Cyango story to the public web.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Cyango tools to publish and do not claim the story is public. Explain that publishing is outside the plugin tools and must be completed manually in xr/studio.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It can read the product catalog of a shop the user already connected in Cyango, and link those products to entities in the story. Checkout happens only in the published Cyango story, outside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Adds xr/stores tools: list the shops connected to the workspace, list their products, link the story to a shop, and place products or link them to story entities so a click opens the product page. The tools do not change shops, products, prices or orders, and do not take payments. Earlier fixes stay: final mutation verification, consistent MCP error signaling, and editor-tab isolation.
